spreads.scene: A child stands on a grassy field, arms outstretched, facing left. A large leaf on the right side of the spread also stands on the grass, bending in the wind with a similar posture. A clear blue sky above.
A child is mid-air, jumping from a grassy hill, arms up. A butterfly on the right is also mid-air, wings spread, carried by the wind. A bright blue sky above with some wispy clouds.

A child runs across a flat, open field, arms back, hair flying. A swallow on the right flies low to the ground, wings spread, mirroring the child's motion. A distant tree line on the horizon under a clear sky.

spreads.scene: A child stands on a small hill, looking up, holding a kite string. A kite flies high in the sky. A hawk on the right soars high, wings spread, mirroring the kite's position. A clear blue sky.

A child holds a hat firmly on her head with both hands, facing into the wind on a grassy plain. A swallow on the right, perched on a fence post, tucks its head, appearing to adjust its feathers against the wind. A light blue sky above.
A child spins around in a circle on a flat field, arms out, dress twirling. A large leaf on the right spins in the air, mimicking the child's movement. A clear blue sky.

A child is captured mid-bounce, feet off the ground, arms slightly bent, in a grassy area. A butterfly on the right is also mid-air, wings up, seemingly pushed by the wind. A light blue sky with fluffy clouds.

A child leans dramatically to one side, resisting a strong gust of wind on a field. A hawk on the right is captured in flight, wings tilted, leaning into the wind. A turbulent sky with fast-moving clouds.

A child stands on a gentle slope, extending one hand forward, palm open, feeling the wind. A large leaf on the right is also held by the wind, with its tip outstretched, mirroring the child's gesture. A clear sky above.
A child stands on a grassy patch, head tilted and slightly shaking, hair blowing. A butterfly on the right is perched on a flower, gently flapping its wings as if shaking them. A sunny sky above.
A child stands on a high point, looking intently at the sky, one hand shielding eyes. A swallow on the right is perched on a branch, head tilted up, also observing the sky. A vast, open blue sky.

A child stands on a hilltop, arms wide open as if embracing an invisible force. A hawk on the right is soaring with wings fully extended, appearing to embrace the air. A vast, dramatic sky with swirling clouds.
